feel._note: Game feel of the monsters' attack impacts by importance (src/hell/hell_monsters.gd _impact; skill gamedev:game-feel): shake = view shake in px (it decays at 30 px/s, smooth sines), hitstop = s the picture holds (only the large tier: a boss's heavy blow), flash = s a white-hot pixel flash lasts at the impact, flash_r = its radius in world px. A mob's impact is one tier below its boss tier (tiny, small, medium). shake_scale scales every shake (accessibility: lower it for less shaking).

knock._note: Knockback of the hero when a monster's blow lands (src/hell/hell_monsters.gd _knock, skill gamedev:physics-tuning): start speed in px/s away from the blow by kind, easing out quadratically over time s (the push covers about speed x time / 3 px); a mob's knock is mob_scale of it. Control stays the hero's; walls stop each axis.

blow._note: Pressure fronts shoving pixels (src/hell/hell_monsters.gd _blow_front, skill gamedev:game-feel): a shockwave's ring and each of a scream's four sound arcs push the pixels they pass outward at push px/s (world) times the arc's share in fronts (first arc to last); the scream's first arc lifts one dust pixel per dust_area px^2 of the cone it sweeps; a front at half share or more makes every lava cell it crosses slosh lava_drops [min, max] drops.

lava._note: Lava sloshing over a pool's rim (src/hell/hell_monsters.gd lava_splash, hell_game.gd _slosh_lava): slosh_rate sloshes per second somewhere in view where lava borders the floor; the lava runs over the rim as a tongue of pixels spill [min, max] world px long for spill_time s and back, leaving a crust of embers; drops [min, max] per slosh are thrown out at speed [min, max] world px/s and up [min, max] px/s; on the floor they glow as embers and cool to soot at soot x the usual darkness; drops falling back into the pool sink.

borrow._note: monsters outside the floors rosters: the mimic chests of the world kit wake as the crypt mimic, drawn hell-coloured (tools/hell_dungeon/build_hell_extras.py)
